verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a versioned public REST API: an OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec, an interactive playground with cURL samples, date-pinned versioning, and a deprecation policy. None of it mentions any official SDK or client library for any language. An OpenAPI spec and cURL samples are developer building blocks that someone could use to generate or write a client, not an official SDK, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Lovable serves its full OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (info title "Lovable API") from the API host itself
